objective.support: all finite responses in the provided training role; all original source NaN and +/-Inf retained as missing support; no held response access
objective.gain: hc=h-mean(h); yc=y-mean(y); g=dot(hc,yc)/dot(hc,hc), or0 if denominator0; positive branches max(0,g)
objective.selection: minimum sum(residual**2); stable original order for ties
objective.intercept: no output intercept; DC is training nuisance projection only

objective.numerical_evaluation: Normalize centered h/y before dot products; frexp/ldexp gain rescaling avoids false zero denominator on finite nonconstant tails. SSE uses normalized residual and frexp/ldexp scaling. Nonrepresentable gain/SSE, including nonzero SSE underflow, is typed refusal of whole context; no grid seed omission.
